title: Rabbids Invasion
description:

A Rabbid walks down the street and steps on some chewing gum; when he realizes that he is stuck, he manages to free himself and ends up rolling under a portico and through a large door that is just closing.

description:

The first days of spring mark spring-cleaning at Hyrule Castle; Link fakes a cold to avoid chores; Ganon infiltrates the castle and, to create a distraction, covertly augments Sprite's magical powers as she too performs cleaning chores.
